title: Director Space Business
description:
Destinus is seeking a Director, Space Business to establish and grow its space business, with military satellite communications (Satcom) as the initial priority. The role covers the complete communications system, including the space segment, user terminals, ground infrastructure and integration with tactical networks.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director will lead business development and programme delivery, supported by programme managers and a Technical Lead with communications systems expertise. The Director must have enough technical depth to challenge proposals and lead informed decisions.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop the business. Define the Satcom business plan, customer priorities, investment needs and Destinus' role in the industrial partnership. Align proposals with technical feasibility, funding and delivery capacity.
  • Secure customers and programmes. Build relationships with defence customers, space agencies and industrial partners. Lead proposals, commercial negotiations and funding opportunities in coordination with the group commercial team.
  • Deliver agreed programmes. Own programme budgets, milestones and customer commitments. Lead programme managers and coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and entry into service.
  • Build the required team. Recruit business and programme staff within approved plans. Define engineering capability needs with the CTO and establish clear responsibilities for internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage industrial partnerships. Select and manage partners and suppliers with the relevant functions. Establish workshare, interfaces and delivery commitments across the complete Satcom system.
  • Develop future opportunities. Assess early warning and interceptor opportunities through customer engagement, partnerships and funding proposals. Present staged investment recommendations before committing development resources.

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

Lightspeed is seeking a Director of Product Management to own the Payments line of business within Financial Services. You will lead Group PMs and Senior PMs across North America and EMEA, and you will be accountable for payments penetration and GPV growth across our Retail and Hospitality platforms.

Financial Services helps merchants get paid faster and with less effort. Success means experiences that are:

  • Integrated: Payments feel native across every surface and workflow.

  • Invisible: Friction is removed and we stay out of the merchant's way.

  • Instant: Funds are fast, accessible, and clearly accounted for.

You own the product strategy and the business outcomes for Payments, including top-line metrics such as total GPV, payments penetration (share of checkout), new paid sold, merchant onboarding conversion, and line of business revenue. You drive multi-year transformations and keep Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams aligned.

You will report to the VP of Product, Financial Services, and partner with Engineering Directors, Design leaders, and Commercial executives.

Key Areas of focus:

  • Strategic Vision and Business Outcomes (35%): Defining a multi-year product vision and roadmap aligned with corporate OKRs, with accountability for driving GPV, market penetration, and revenue growth.

  • Organizational Leadership and Talent (25%): Developing and empowering Group Product Managers and Staff Product Managers, while driving effective hiring, building a strong team culture, and establishing succession plans.

title: Caller / Scheduler
description:
Unison is a telecom and renewables infrastructure investment firm funded in partnership with Ardian - the global investment house based in Paris with over $150 billion in assets under management. Unison commenced operations in 2003 and today invests in real estate and infrastructure hosting wireless and renewables tenants in the United States and Europe. The Company is expanding rapidly and looking for talented, entrepreneurial team members to grow with us.

THE TEAM:

The Unison team is looking for an energetic, thorough caller to be the first point of contact for a pipeline of real estate investment leads. Reporting to the Director of Lead Generation, the Caller / Scheduler is responsible for helping grow the company by setting appointments for the Account Managers with real estate property owners to assist in developing a robust sales pipeline.

THE JOB:

Manage personal pipeline of origination leads to set calls between site owners and Account Managers.

Achieve personal monthly, quarterly, and annual targets related to call settings and closings.

Rigorously monitor personal origination waterfall activity to ensure health and stability of sales pipeline.

Contribute user-experience input to origination processes such as data mining, CRM design, and marketing initiatives.

Contribute to strategic initiatives and product design to maintain a competitive market position.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Prior experience in a call-center sales environment.

Natural ability to build rapport.

Familiarity with finance concepts such as IRR and NPV required.

Familiarity with real estate closing process is a plus.

Experience originating within commercial real estate, mortgages, telecom, mineral rights acquisition, or renewables industries is a plus.

Some college or equivalent experience required.

title: Business Analyst Processes and Data
description:
For a renowned Swiss bank in Zurich, we are looking for an experienced business analyst. You analyse processes, data flows and systems in customer and contract management or in real estate management, and derive target pictures and decision bases from them.

Your tasks

  1. Analyse and document processes, data flows, systems and responsibilities end to end

  2. Create the as-is analysis, derive the target picture and to-be processes, define data ownership

  4. Create business cases, effort estimates and risk analyses

  5. Moderate workshops and present results at management level

Your profile

  1. German at C2 level, the project language is German. Understanding of Swiss German is expected

  2. Several years as a business analyst or data analyst in banking or comparable industries

  3. Process and data analysis with BPMN, UML and visualisation tools

  4. Understanding of IT architecture, system landscapes, interfaces and data flows

  5. Confident use of Excel, PowerPoint, Jira and Confluence

Nice to have

  1. Customer and contract management, Siebel CRM

  2. Practical experience with AI tools in business analysis

  3. Power BI or Tableau, basic knowledge of CAFM and ERP

title: Director, Advisory and Risk Consulting
description:
We are now seeking an experienced, commercially minded resilience management expert who can help clients anticipate, withstand and recover from complex disruptions while also building trusted, long-term client relationships. As the Director you will combine deep expertise in resilience, crisis, business continuity and risk management with the ability to manage existing accounts, and identify new opportunities to sell, originate and grow work in the German market. This role requires an individual with strong social skills, executive presence, a “refuse to lose” attitude, and the confidence to advise boards and senior executives, present ideas in a compelling way and translate complex thinking into clear, persuasive and structured client communications.

Business Development

  • Proactively manage accounts, identify prospects, build senior client relationships and generate new business opportunities for Control Risks, with a primary focus on corporate and government accounts throughout Germany.
  • Work closely with your advisory & risk consulting team, account managers, Service Line leaders and the Managing Director in a consultative sales capacity, entering client conversations as a subject matter expert, shaping opportunities and helping to close new work.
  • Own and deepen relationships with new and existing clients, demonstrating commercial persistence, high social intelligence and a “refuse to lose” approach to winning and retaining work.
  • Own and manage a qualified sales pipeline from prospecting and qualification through scoping, proposal development, negotiation and close, with clear accountability for converting opportunities into profitable work.
  • Develop targeted account plans by identifying the right accounts for Control Risks, prioritising growth accounts of relevant size and potential, mapping decision-makers and buyer groups, and pursuing cross-selling opportunities across service lines.

location: London or remote within the UK
description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

You will partner closely with Core Tech, Product, and Engineering leadership to define our security roadmap and culture.

We’re excited about you because you are a trailblazer who balances high-level strategy with hands-on technical execution. You are comfortable building from near-scratch, thrive on educating others, and possess a "platform" mindset that prioritizes empowering developers over acting as a gatekeeper.

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. Cold calling and outbound prospecting are a core part of the job, so it suits someone who enjoys both landing the first deal and then multiplying it.

You won't be running site go-lives, resolving driver appeals or chasing operational issues. Our Client Success Managers own the day-to-day running of each account, so your time goes on the commercial relationship, the next site and the next logo.

Mantenendo questo obiettivo, e perseguendolo con passione costante, l’azienda ha negli anni diversificato la sua produzione, sviluppando, oltre al settore tessile, anche quello chimico. Fu una scelta strategica importante, avvenuta negli anni ’50, che aprì poi la strada alla nobilitazione tessile. Nella seconda metà del Novecento, tra gli anni ’70 e gli anni ’90, questa integrazione ha fatto sì che si potesse potenziare lo sviluppo della ricerca nelle sezioni dedicate alla pelletteria, agli accessori, all’abbigliamento, alla calzatura, fino all’automotive. Limonta è cresciuta anno dopo anno, riuscendo però in un’impresa difficile quanto fondamentale, i cui risultati durano ancora oggi: conservare, in un corpo industriale, un’anima artigianale. Siamo sempre pronti, seguendo questo spirito, a investire nelle imprese e nelle innovazioni più avvincenti del mercato      La Business Unit Limonta Society (B2C)  produce e vende, anche attraverso negozi propri e multimarca presenti in tutto il mondo, biancheria per la casa dedicata alla fascia alta del mercato. As a Senior FX Sales Executive, you'll play a key role in expanding DIGITEC's presence, with a strong focus on acquiring new clients and developing strategic business opportunities within the FX market.

  • Identify market opportunities and develop effective strategies to expand DIGITEC's presence.

description:
Account Manager

About Us

ClaimSorted helps insurers outsource claims end to end – a service called Third-Party Administration (TPA), a ~$200B industry. We combine a strong in-house claims team with our AI-enabled platform to deliver up to 3× faster claims, better service, and better economics for insurers.

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We’re a high-intensity team because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

   At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

You’ll decide what to build by its value in loans and euros, prove what works against holdout groups, and treat every customer fairly: a loan is a financial decision, not a shopping cart.

 Build and run customer journeys in Braze across the lifecycle: application and onboarding, repeat loans and add-ons, reactivation, and payment difficulty, with QA before every launch and zero customer-facing errors.
